jobs.title: Investment Designer (Contract)

pay_input_ranges.title: The estimated base pay range for this role is listed below.
pay_input_ranges.blurb:
At SIE, we consider several factors when setting each role’s base pay range, including the competitive benchmarking data for the market and geographic location.

Please note that the base pay range may vary in line with our hybrid working policy and individual base pay will be determined based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. 

In addition, this role is eligible for SIE’s top-tier benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, matching 401(k), paid time off, wellness program and coveted employee discounts for Sony products. This role also may be eligible for a bonus package. Click here to learn more.

jobs.ai_disclaimer:
Use of AI in Recruiting 


We use artificial intelligence and other automated tools to assist with certain aspects of our recruiting process, including reviewing applications and supporting candidate evaluation. For example, we use Greenhouse's AI-powered Talent Matching tool to compare information in your application against job-related qualifications and criteria established by our recruiting team. More information about Greenhouse, including about its features and its Privacy Policy, may be found at its website. These tools assist our recruiting team and do not make hiring decisions.
